title: Appoint a food safety supervisor
what: Have a food safety supervisor for the licensed food business within 30 days of the licence being issued.

sources.title: Food Act 2006 (Qld)
sources.quote: A licensee must, within 30 days after the licence is issued under section 60 (1), have a food safety supervisor for the food business under the licence
